scope: Kubernetes v1.36.1 validating admission for fixture ClusterRole updates and matching contributors, enforced selector stability, followed by live ClusterRole aggregation into a case-owned aggregate role. Only get on a case-owned ConfigMap is exercised by an independent consumer through a namespace RoleBinding. A labeled CRD alone does not contribute rules. Built-in roles, other aggregate selectors, deployments, and production policy are not tested.
